turns.prompt_text: how can you get liquid to come out of your nose
turns.response_html:
Liquid often comes out of your nose due to excess mucus from conditions like a cold, flu, allergies, or sinusitis, or from irritation caused by cold air or spicy food.

You can help clear liquid/mucus using methods like:

  • Gently blowing your nose.
  • Using a saline nasal spray or rinse (like a neti pot) to thin and flush out mucus.
  • Inhaling steam from a hot shower or bowl of hot water.
  • Staying hydrated to help thin the mucus.

If you have a persistent, clear, watery discharge, especially after head trauma, consult a doctor as it could rarely be a cerebrospinal fluid (brain fluid) leak.

turns.prompt_text: I have a blood pouch that you can bite and it will emit fake blood how can I make that fake blood come out of my nose
turns.response_html:
Do not put anything inside your nose, including fake blood, as this can be unsafe and may cause irritation or infection.

For a nosebleed effect, you can use a small amount of runny, theatrical fake blood applied outside your nostril with a dropper or cotton swab, then let it drip down your face naturally with gravity.
